links.outcome: Agreement of AI preclassification with manual microscopy on local pediatric samples
links.effect: High correlation for neutrophils (rho=0.742) and lymphocytes (rho=0.745); blast cells rho=0.079; kappa 0.21 for monocytes and 0.08 for blast cells.
links.quote: Concordance between the MC-80 and manual microscopy was minimal for monocytes (κ = 0.21; 95% CI: 0.11-0.29) and negligible for blast cells (κ = 0.08; 95% CI: 0.00-0.17).

screen.reason: Evaluates the diagnostic accuracy and clinical performance of an automated AI-based digital morphology analyzer on pediatric blood smears in comparison to manual light microscopy.
